key_insight: OmniTongue reveals substantial gaps in MLLMs’ ability to interpret fine-grained tongue features in Traditional Chinese Medicine.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research on automated TCM tongue assessment but does not establish clinical readiness or diagnostic validity.
method: Constructed a visual question-answering benchmark from expert-validated tongue images.
Covered 16 clinical dimensions and 66 fine-grained labels.
Used region-specific annotations to evaluate localized feature recognition.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on 1,351 images and 21,616 instruction pairs found poor Macro-F1 scores across tested MLLMs and no domain advantage for medical-specific models.
watch_item: Low Macro-F1 suggests uneven label recognition; clinical deployment would require validation beyond this benchmark.
paper_title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
